headlines.title: 国有大行火速行动，全国多地首笔房贷贴息业务落地

headlines.title_en: Major state-owned banks act swiftly, first mortgage interest subsidy business lands in multiple regions nationwide
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 10 — On September 29, the Ministry of Finance, the People's Bank of China and other departments issued the Notice on Implementing the Interest Subsidy Policy for Residents' Home Purchase Loans, specifying that starting October 1 this year, the interest subsidy policy for residents' home purchase loans will be implemented nationwide to ease the interest burden of commercial personal housing loans for families newly purchasing their first home. As of October 10, the policy has been in formal nationwide implementation for ten days. After the policy was introduced, major state-owned banks responded actively and moved swiftly to ensure it took effect. During the National Day holiday, multiple provinces and cities across the country successfully implemented their first batch of mortgage interest subsidy business, with many eligible first-time homebuyers among the first to benefit, effectively easing pressure on housing purchases.

headlines.title: 商务部：继续就欧盟对逆变器项目融资指导文件等问题保持沟通
headlines.summary: 商务部欧洲司负责人解读中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会成果：双方同意发挥贸易监测机制作用，探讨双方在世贸组织规则框架下降低部分商品关税可能性，并就欧盟外国补贴条例开展技术对话，为中欧贸易投资合作营造公平、透明、可预期的环境。双方愿在此前良好合作的基础上，就医疗器械和农产品等领域的市场准入问题进行交流，并继续就欧盟对逆变器项目融资指导文件、化妆品和药品监管等问题保持沟通。双方就电动汽车、混动汽车贸易进行了深入讨论，避免了局面升级，有力维护了中国企业的实际出口利益和中欧混动汽车贸易的稳定发展。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Will continue communication with the EU on issues including the guidance document for inverter project financing
headlines.summary_en: An official of the European Affairs Department of the Ministry of Commerce interpreted the outcomes of the second meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism: both sides agreed to leverage the trade monitoring mechanism, explore the possibility of reducing tariffs on certain goods under the framework of WTO rules, and hold technical dialogue on the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation, so as to foster a fair, transparent and predictable environment for China-EU trade and investment cooperation. On the basis of previous sound cooperation, both sides are willing to exchange views on market access issues in areas such as medical devices and agricultural products, and to continue communication on issues including the EU guidance document on financing for inverter projects and cosmetics and pharmaceutical regulation. The two sides held in-depth discussions on trade in electric vehicles and hybrid vehicles, averting an escalation of the situation and effectively safeguarding the practical export interests of Chinese enterprises and the stable development of China-EU hybrid vehicle trade.

headlines.title_en: SAMR conditionally approves Focus Media's acquisition of New Trend Media equity
headlines.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation issued an announcement approving, with restrictive conditions attached, the case of Focus Media Information Technology Co., Ltd. (Focus Media) acquiring equity in Chengdu Xinchao Media Group Co., Ltd. (Xinchao Media). After review, the State Administration for Market Regulation concluded that the case may have the effect of eliminating or restricting competition in China's elevator media advertising market. To effectively reduce the possible adverse effects of this concentration of undertakings, the State Administration for Market Regulation, after comprehensive review and scientific assessment, made a conditional approval decision in accordance with the law, requiring Focus Media, Xinchao Media and the post-concentration entity to make six restrictive commitments: continue to perform existing customer contracts and all their commercial terms; continue to maintain service levels for customers; the annual actual transaction prices of the post-concentration entity in each city shall not exceed the corresponding actual transaction prices of Focus Media and Xinchao Media in the respective cities in the 24 months prior to the effective date

headlines.title: 截至9月底 我国基本养老保险参保人数达10.79亿人
headlines.summary: 国务院新闻办公室今天（10月10日）上午举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，人力资源社会保障部相关负责人介绍推进就业和社会保障高质量发展有关情况。在社会保障方面，截至9月底，全国基本养老保险、失业保险、工伤保险（含职业伤害保障）参保人数分别达到10.79亿人、2.51亿人、3.27亿人，三项社会保险基金累计结余11.2万亿元。

headlines.title_en: As of end-September, the number of people covered by basic endowment insurance in China reached 1.079 billion
headlines.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a series of themed press conferences this morning (October 10) on "Starting Off and Setting Out for the 15th Five-Year Plan." A relevant official from the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security introduced progress on promoting high-quality development of employment and social security. In terms of social security, as of the end of September, the number of people covered by national basic old-age insurance, unemployment insurance, and work-related injury insurance (including occupational injury protection) reached 1.079 billion, 251 million, and 327 million, respectively, and the cumulative surplus of the three social insurance funds reached 11.2 trillion yuan.

headlines.summary: 商务部等7部门发布关于实施品质电商“五优”行动的通知，其中提到，加强品质电商主体培育。用好展会活动等平台，组织电商平台聚焦产品和服务质量提升公开发布承诺和行动计划，发布平台质量治理报告，主动接受社会监督，打造品质电商发展“主阵地”。发挥国家电子商务示范基地引领、辐射带动和质量科普作用，以品质为导向开展示范创建，强化信用管理和分类指导，培育一批诚信经营的品质标杆平台。

headlines.title_en: Seven departments: Rectify disorderly competition behaviors on e-commerce platforms such as 'automatic price matching' and 'lowest price across the entire network'
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce and six other departments issued a notice on implementing the "Five Excellences" action for quality e-commerce, which mentioned strengthening the cultivation of quality e-commerce entities. Make good use of exhibition activities and other platforms, organize e-commerce platforms to publicly release commitments and action plans focused on improving product and service quality, publish platform quality governance reports, proactively accept social supervision, and build a "main battlefield" for the development of quality e-commerce. Give play to the leading, radiating, driving, and quality science popularization role of national e-commerce demonstration bases, carry out demonstration creation with quality as the orientation, strengthen credit management and categorized guidance, and cultivate a group of quality benchmark platforms that operate with integrity.

headlines.title: 最高年化22%？多家香港银行推出限时高息定存
headlines.summary: 香港地区多家银行近期推出高利率存款产品，建银亚洲“贵宾理财”客户可享最高8.88%特惠定存年利率，新客户手机开户可享5.88%的人民币或港币定存年利率。平安数字银行符合条件的用户可开立1个月港元定期存款，最高享18%定期存款年利率。

headlines.title_en: Up to 22% annualized? Multiple Hong Kong banks launch limited-time high-interest time deposits
headlines.summary_en: Several banks in Hong Kong have recently launched high-interest deposit products. CCB Asia "VIP Wealth Management" customers can enjoy a special fixed deposit annual interest rate of up to 8.88%, and new customers opening accounts via mobile can enjoy a 5.88% annual interest rate on RMB or HKD fixed deposits. Eligible users of Ping An Digital Bank can open a 1-month HKD time deposit with an annual interest rate of up to 18%.

headlines.title: 韩国延长对原产于中国的镀锌冷轧钢临时反倾销税期限
headlines.summary: 据中国贸易救济信息网，10月8日，韩国企划财政部发布第2026-107号公告，将原产于中国的镀锌冷轧钢临时反倾销税期限由四个月（2026年6月12日至2026年10月11日）延长至七个月（2026年6月12日至2027年1月11日）。

headlines.title_en: South Korea extends temporary anti-dumping duties on galvanized cold-rolled steel originating from China
headlines.summary_en: According to the China Trade Remedy Information Network, on October 8, South Korea's Ministry of Economy and Finance issued Announcement No. 2026-107, extending the provisional anti-dumping duty period on galvanized cold-rolled steel originating in China from four months (June 12, 2026 to October 11, 2026) to seven months (June 12, 2026 to January 11, 2027).

headlines.title_en: Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min meets with Goldman Sachs President John Waldron
headlines.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 9, 2026, Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min met in Beijing with John Waldron, President and Chief Operating Officer of Goldman Sachs Group, and the two sides exchanged views on topics including China-US economic and trade relations and the macroeconomic situations of China and the United States.

headlines.title: 北京：加大新能源汽车推广力度 培育汽车消费新增长点
headlines.summary: 北京市人民政府印发《北京市“十五五”时期深化国际消费中心城市建设规划》，其中提到，加大新能源汽车推广力度。进一步完善二手车流通体系,促进二手车便利交易,推动交易市场标准化、规模化发展。优化维修、保险等服务供给,有序发展汽车改装、租赁、赛事及房车露营等汽车后市场消费。加快推进汽车流通消费改革试点,培育汽车消费新增长点。

headlines.title_en: Beijing: Step up promotion of new energy vehicles, cultivate new growth drivers for auto consumption
headlines.summary_en: The Beijing Municipal People's Government issued the Beijing Plan for Deepening the Development of an International Consumption Center City During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period, which mentions increasing efforts to promote new energy vehicles. It calls for further improving the used-car circulation system, facilitating convenient used-car transactions, and promoting the standardized and large-scale development of the trading market. It also calls for optimizing the supply of services such as maintenance and insurance, and developing in an orderly manner aftermarket auto consumption including vehicle modification, leasing, racing and RV camping. It calls for accelerating the pilot reform of automobile circulation and consumption and cultivating new growth points in auto consumption.

headlines.title: 商务部欧洲司负责人解读中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会成果
headlines.summary: 10月8-9日，中国商务部部长王文涛与欧盟委员会贸易和经济安全委员马罗什·谢夫乔维奇在北京共同主持召开中欧贸易投资磋商机制（以下简称机制）第二次例会。双方围绕贸易和投资平衡、出口管制、知识产权、世贸组织改革等议题开展对等、专业、建设性的会谈，全面盘点了机制首次会议以来的磋商情况及各项进展，并形成了成果共识。商务部欧洲司负责人就相关成果进行解读。

headlines.title_en: Director-General of the Department of European Affairs of the Ministry of Commerce interprets the outcomes of the second meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism
headlines.summary_en: On October 8-9, Chinese Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao and European Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security Maros Sefcovic co-chaired the second meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism (the Mechanism) in Beijing. The two sides held reciprocal, professional and constructive talks on topics including trade and investment balance, export controls, intellectual property rights and WTO reform, comprehensively reviewed the consultations and progress since the first meeting of the Mechanism, and reached consensus on outcomes. An official of the European Affairs Department of the Ministry of Commerce interpreted the relevant outcomes.

headlines.title: 印度对涉华合金破岩器反倾销案启动反规避调查
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月10日讯，据中国贸易救济信息网，9月28日，印度商工部发布公告称，应印度国内企业DOZCO (India) Pvt. Ltd.提交的申请，对原产于或进口自中国和韩国的全组装合金破岩器（液压岩石破碎机和合金钢凿具）反倾销案启动反规避调查，审查中国和韩国的涉案产品是否经由马来西亚出口至印度以规避现行反倾销税。本案倾销调查期为2025年4月至2026年3月（12个月），损害调查期为2022年至2023年、2023年至2024年、2024年至2025年以及2025年4月至2026年3月。本案涉及印度海关编码8409、8412、8430和8431项下

headlines.title_en: India launches anti-circumvention investigation into anti-dumping case on alloy rock breakers involving China
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 10 — According to the China Trade Remedy Information Network, on September 28, India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry issued an announcement stating that, in response to an application filed by the Indian domestic company DOZCO (India) Pvt. Ltd., it has launched an anti-circumvention investigation into the anti-dumping case on fully assembled alloy rock breakers (hydraulic rock breakers and alloy steel chisels) originating in or imported from China and South Korea, to examine whether the products concerned from China and South Korea are exported to India via Malaysia to circumvent existing anti-dumping duties. The dumping investigation period of this case is April 2025 to March 2026 (12 months), and the injury investigation period covers 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and April 2025 to March 2026. The case involves Indian customs codes 8409, 8412, 8430 and 8431
